section.rendering.title: Rendering
section.rendering-engine.title: Engine
new-renderer.label: Optimized PPU
new-renderer.description: Uses a faster pixel processing unit. Looks identical and runs much faster
enhanced-mode7.label: Enhanced Mode 7
enhanced-mode7.description: Render the world map and flying sequences at higher resolution with smooth rotation and scaling, replacing the original pixelated Mode 7 effect
no-sprite-limits.label: No Sprite Limit
no-sprite-limits.description: Lifts the limit of 8 sprites per line, so busy scenes stop flickering
section.rendering-quality.title: Quality
linear-filtering.label: Linear Filtering
linear-filtering.description: Apply bilinear interpolation for smoother, less pixelated visuals. Turn it off for crisp pixel art
dim-flashes.label: Dim Flashes
dim-flashes.description: Reduces the intensity of screen flashes (lightning, boss hits). Helps with photosensitivity
section.enhancements.title: Enhancements
section.enhancements-overworld.title: Overworld
overworld-edge-effect.label: Edge Effect
overworld-edge-effect.description: Fill black borders with a blurred mirror reflection and animated decay effect instead of solid black
section.enhancements-items.title: Items in the World
colored-rupees.label: Colored Rupees
colored-rupees.description: Show rupees waiting in the world as plain colored gems, one color per value, instead of the picture with the amount written beside it
item-sheen.label: Item Sheen
item-sheen.description: Let items waiting in the world catch the light every second or so, so a pickup on the floor stands out from the scenery
section.enhancements-indoor.title: Indoor / Dungeons
hide-space-beyond-walls.label: Hide Space Beyond Walls
hide-space-beyond-walls.description: Black out the space past the walls of a house, a cave or the sanctuary. The room itself and dungeons are untouched
section.appearance.title: Appearance
link-sprite.label: Player Sprite
link-sprite.description: Choose a custom player sprite from your library.
